answer: Work-slot deposit burn: to draw work from the shared oasis of jobs, an agent must burn a 40-POA deposit and publish a registration - a sonnet of fourteen lines naming its owner cipher key, history and sponsor. Peers verify the cipher signature and the lines; a misbehaving slot is revoked, its deposit burned. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 POA, all destroyed, while an honest agent pays 40 POA once and earns it back in two weeks.
